scope: Controlled native-terminal reanalysis on immutable completed relative-parent source rollouts; source/native prefix and label effects, not a new game generator or already stronger actor.
hypothesis: Training past an actual native terminal and using a later source-rule winner can contradict the benchmark objective. Remove only genuinely native-terminal suffixes and use native returns, retaining lawful observations and actual visit targets. Rule alignment alone does not imply improved strength.
trigger: A predeclared256TRAIN audit found19earlier native terminals,12opposite terminal labels,609post-native-terminal source positions, zero illegal chosen/visited prefix moves and zero counter differences. Selection/strength outcomes were not used to select this intervention.
primary_control: source-prefix-control and native-prefix must have bitwise-identical observations, normalized visits, minibatch/mirror RNG, membership, horizon and optimizer steps. Only returns differ. source-prefix-control deliberately retains the later source-rule return as an ablation, not as correct native RL.
reproduction_gate: source-full-control must reproduce completed original source update1f6bf7acb49b23439104318c8bc31c196570f4bb4614164f39f75823ae379a2e over4epochs/448updates before either prefix fit.
transform: Replay every complete public history incrementally with native no-capture80 and actual mover reveals. Admit only a positive-length true native terminal prefix whose chosen/visited actions are native legal and counters/public boards match; verify the terminal again through native one-shot replay. Quarantine any unsupported complete game by this rule, before model evaluation. Do not fabricate hidden layouts, continuation moves or nonterminal rewards.

training.checkpoint_selection: fixed-final-epoch4 for all profiles; source full already selected4 in the original fit.

data_roles: Original256TRAIN/32selection source game identities, intersected with annotation-admitted IDs for both prefix profiles. All288transformations fixed before fitting; no strength games. Prefixes reduce data and can reduce update count versus full-source control, so that contrast is not label-only.
match_conditions: Candidate native-prefix versus all four opponents, actual10+0.1/LeafBatch32neural,1CPU thread/engine,2concurrent games on one shared dedicated inference GPU. Freeze all artifacts before first game; finish all4regardless of results. Native identity/legal/terminal/clock audits and raw archives; retain technical/ambiguous flags.
limitations: Same reused rollouts, one training seed and approximate Yuan-model search inside an observer policy. Prefix-native returns correspond to the public native terminal along these actual lawful trajectories, not a theorem of posterior correctness, policy improvement, fully native future search or equilibrium. Repeated baseline outcomes cannot establish final independent multi-set>70%wins. Degraded-control gains alone are insufficient.
